Announcement27 July 2025·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com
Two Years of ArcheAge Classic — Thank You
Two years already. It’s been trade runs, treasure maps, sea battles, and sieges. It’s been broken alliances and lasting friendships. It’s been Classic. Together, you’ve: - Fished up fish - Delivered trade packs - Regraded items We’ve come a long way — and we couldn’t have done it without you. > for being here, building…

Two years already. It’s been trade runs, treasure maps, sea battles, and sieges. It’s been broken alliances and lasting friendships. It’s been Classic.

Together, you’ve:

  • Fished up 1,930,382 fish
  • Delivered 4,791,633 trade packs
  • Regraded 6,145,424 items

We’ve come a long way — and we couldn’t have done it without you.

Thank you for being here, building this world with us, and keeping the fire alive.

Let’s celebrate how far we’ve come — and where we’re headed next.

:gift: Anniversary Event Weekend

August 1st – August 4th

  • :small_blue_diamond: Double Honor, Vocation, Prestige & Family XP
  • :small_blue_diamond: Castaway Treasure Chests return
  • :small_blue_diamond: A new Priceless Coin to collect (and spend soon...)

We’ll see you in Erenor — and on August 4th, the day it all began, we’ll have a little more to share.

– The ArcheAge Classic Team
